BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning the unlawful disposition of human remains.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the unlawful disposition of human remains; amending RCW 68.50.130; and prescribing penalties.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 68.50.130 and 2019 c 432 s 21 are each amended to read as follows:Unlawful disposal of remains. (Effective May 1, 2020.)
BillSection.P: Every person who performs a disposition of any human remains, except as otherwise provided by law, in any place, except in a cemetery or a building dedicated exclusively for religious purposes, is guilty of a misdemeanor class C felony. Disposition of human remains following cremation, alkaline hydrolysis, or natural organic reduction may also occur on private property, with the consent of the property owner; and on public or government lands or waters with the approval of the government agency that has either jurisdiction or control, or both, of the lands or waters.

AnnNote.NoteP: Effective date—2019 c 432: See note following RCW 68.05.175.
